audit_metadata.title: Audit 1: Clean Read-Only Security & Architectural Reconnaissance Audit
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer & Enterprise Security Architect
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Phase 1: Foundation Infrastructure, Cryptographic Security & Asynchronous Webhook Pipeline

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: Zero offshore AI dispatches; inference isolated to UAE sovereign compute; Meta Cloud API UAE Local Storage configured

fr_3_3_webhook_latency_sla.verification: FastAPI webhook decouples payload to Celery asynchronously via apply_async in <30ms, satisfying <500ms Meta SLA

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_b_segregation.verification: Citizen phone pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; raw phone purged from worker memory frame

fr_4_1_ephemeral_transit_ttl.verification: Celery broker message enqueued with expires=60s; verified via test_webhook_post_success_mocked

nfr_1_3_salt_entropy.verification: Pydantic validator enforces CITIZEN_HASH_SALT length >= 32 characters

security_headers.verification: FastAPI middleware injects CSP, nosniff, DENY, HSTS, and no-referrer

tri_network_isolation.verification: docker-compose isolates DB and Redis exclusively on internal: true bridge without default gateway

non_root_execution.verification: Dockerfile runner stage enforces USER hares:hares (UID 10001)

observations_and_findings.title: Robust JSON Decoding Exception Handling in Webhook Handler
observations_and_findings.description: Calling await request.json() after signature verification can raise json.JSONDecodeError if payload is malformed.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Wrap in try/except json.JSONDecodeError returning HTTP 400 Bad Request.

observations_and_findings.title: Redis Broker Connection Fault Tolerance
observations_and_findings.description: Celery apply_async raises kombu.exceptions.OperationalError if Redis is unavailable, returning unhandled HTTP 500.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Handle broker operational exceptions gracefully and return HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with retry headers.

observations_and_findings.title: Token-Bucket Citizen Rate Limiter Wiring
observations_and_findings.description: RATE_LIMIT_QUERIES_PER_HOUR=5 configured in Settings; physical Redis sliding window counter is scheduled for Phase 2.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Implement atomic Redis INCR + EXPIRE sliding window check in worker task.

observations_and_findings.title: Deterministic Allowlist & IDN Homograph Engine Implementation
observations_and_findings.description: Specifications finalized in goal/; physical modules (src/hares/engine/) scheduled for Phase 2 implementation.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Implement allowlist.py and homograph.py with Arabic Unicode block regex validation.

observations_and_findings.title: PostgreSQL SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM & Alembic Migrations
observations_and_findings.description: Database schemas defined in SYSTEM_STATE.md; physical ORM models and Alembic migrations scheduled for Phase 2.
observations_and_findings.remediation: Author SQLAlchemy 2.0 async models and Alembic initial migration in src/hares/db/.
